nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: Expected input: { prompt_key, variables: {...}, user_id, related_record_type?, related_record_id?, feature?, model?, max_tokens?, enable_web_search?, image_data?, image_media_type? }. enable_web_search added in Phase 7 for the Research Agent. image_data/image_media_type added in Phase 8 (base64, no data: prefix) for image analysis - everyone else leaves both unset.

nodes.name: Fill Template
nodes.notes: Loads the versioned prompt (step 2 of the AI orchestration pattern) and fills {{variable}} placeholders (step 1: structured input received via trigger, applied here).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.model, max_tokens: $json.max_tokens, system: $json.system_prompt, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.image_data ? [{ type: 'image', source: { type: 'base64', media_type: $json.image_media_type, data: $json.image_data } }, { type: 'text', text: $json.user_message }] : $json.user_message }], ...($json.enable_web_search ? { tools: [{ type: 'web_search_20260209', name: 'web_search' }] } : {}) }) }}

nodes.name: Call Claude
nodes.notes: Step 3 of the AI orchestration pattern. Model/max_tokens come from Fill Template so future callers can override per feature (e.g. cheaper model for simple classification). Phase 7: tools only added when enable_web_search is set (Research Agent) - server-side tool, Claude searches and answers in the same response, no client-side tool loop needed.

nodes.name: Validate & Parse Response
nodes.notes: Step 4: validates the response (throws - triggering the Error Workflow - on refusal or empty content). Attempts JSON parse for structured-output prompts, falls back to raw text for prose prompts.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ user_id: $('Capture Start').first().json.user_id, feature: $('Capture Start').first().json.feature || $('Fill Template').first().json.prompt_key, prompt_key: $('Fill Template').first().json.prompt_key, prompt_version: $('Fill Template').first().json.prompt_version, model_used: $json.model, input_tokens: $json.input_tokens, output_tokens: $json.output_tokens, related_record_type: $('Capture Start').first().json.related_record_type || null, related_record_id: $('Capture Start').first().json.related_record_id || null }) }}

nodes.name: Log AI Usage
nodes.notes: estimated_cost_usd is left null here - per-token pricing varies by model and changes over time, so cost is computed dashboard-side from model_used + token counts rather than hardcoded into this workflow.

nodes.name: Return Result
nodes.notes: Step 6: returns structured JSON to whichever workflow called this one.
